ModMetaData.name: Ordered Work (Core)
ModMetaData.author: nightmare123487
ModMetaData.description: Work Control (0.3.0-alpha.10). Interaction and drag-palette iteration. The vanilla Work tab now respects simple mode: when useWorkPriorities is off, our numeric cells defer to the vanilla checkboxes; in manual mode the 0..max numeric cells remain (right-click jumps from 0 to max, otherwise decrements). Values above 4 are written straight into the private priorities map with a notify, so the "invalid priority" log spam is gone, and the View: Draw return button is fixed to the real DoWindowContents parameter and also appears under Compact Work Tab (which uses the same window). Work Control gains a single compact WorkType palette row: drag a WorkType onto a pawn row for a ghost insertion marker; valid drops add or reorder at that position, incapable types are skipped with one grouped message, and multi-selection applies the same WorkType/position to every selected pawn. The fixed pawn column now shows the portrait plus an ellipsized name/title, compact right-side age/health, and a row tooltip with full name, age, title, health and active WorkType count. Everything else is kept: selection via Find.Selector, Recommend/Details, View: Numeric/Draw redirects, search filtering, flat cards, pins/scoring, hooks, respawn and save/load. No profiles, schedules, equipment or multi-pawn. Do not use in a main save; back up your save first.
